name: Ella
label: Unicorn
lyrics:
Verse 1:  
In a land where rainbows glow,  
Ella rides where the flowers grow,  
With a sparkle in her eyes so bright,  
She dances with unicorns in the light.  

Chorus:  
Ella, Ella, come and play,  
With unicorns, it’s a magical day!  
Ella, Ella, sing out loud,  
Join the fun and feel so proud!  

Verse 2:  
Through the fields, they prance and leap,  
Ella giggles, her joy runs deep,  
With a swish of tails and a happy cheer,  
Unicorns and Ella, spreading love here!  

Chorus:  
Ella, Ella, come and play,  
With unicorns, it’s a magical day!  
Ella, Ella, sing out loud,  
Join the fun and feel so proud!
caption:
This one goes out to every Ella who loves unicorns 🎶 Want one with YOUR kid's name? Make it in about a minute at shoutoutsong.com (link in bio)
